It's not unreasonable to expect your partner to prioritize family time, especially when you've made an effort to spend quality time with them. Your husband's response seems dismissive and unempathetic, which can be hurtful and frustrating. In terms of being an asshole, I'd say you're not one. You're simply expressing your feelings and needs, which is a normal and healthy part of any relationship.
